records.body:

draft.subject: Next step for Blue Dynamics in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Glad the pagination question got resolved — list endpoints use cursor-based pagination, so that one's settled on our side too.

You've got your first project created, which is the main thing: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The usual next step is getting your team in alongside you — a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through whatever's next for Blue Dynamics.

Best,
Chidi
